purpose: Minimum machine-readable lineage needed to turn a compact distance-ladder fit into named, covariance-preserving interventions without reverse-engineering identities from matrix shape.

parameters.rule: Every design-matrix column must have one stable identifier and an explicit transform from the stored coefficient to the reported physical parameter.

observations.rule: Every data-vector row must map to its measurement identity; null is allowed only when the field is inapplicable, never when the identity is unknown.

covariance.rule: Removing a named branch must remove its rows and every covariance component descended from that branch, then recompute any selection-dependent uncertainty rather than slicing a printed table.

independence.rule: Development and final adjudication must use non-overlapping observations or an explicit shared-ancestor graph with cluster-aware uncertainty.

validation.causalClaimGate: No named anchor, host, instrument, method, or photometric-system influence may be reported until parameter, row, covariance-ancestry, and current-branch coverage all equal one.
